result.instructions: Tools for Housecall Pro, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Housecall Pro data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run housecall_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run housecall_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run housecall_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. housecall_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: housecall_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the Housecall Pro company this key belongs to — name, contact details, address, time zone, service-area zip codes and (multi-location) its locations. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Housecall Pro: GET /company.

tools.name: housecall_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers, with their phone numbers, tags and addresses. `q` searches name, email, mobile number and address. Housecall Pro: GET /customers.

q.description: Search by name, email, mobile number or address.

sort_by.description: Customer attribute to sort by, e.g. created_at.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

expand.description: Extras to include in each customer.

tools.name: housecall_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id, including their addresses (whose ids you need to create a job or estimate). Housecall Pro: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs, filterable by scheduled window, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each job carries its customer, address, notes, schedule, assigned employees and totals. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs.

scheduled_start_min.description: Only jobs starting at or after this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_start_max.description: Only jobs starting at or before this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_end_min.description: Only jobs ending at or after this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_end_max.description: Only jobs ending at or before this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

employee_ids.description: Only records assigned to these employee ids.

work_status.description: Only these work statuses. All statuses if omitted.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

tools.name: housecall_get_job
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch a single job by id — customer, address, work status and timestamps, schedule, assigned employees, notes and totals. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_line_items
tools.title: List a job's line items
tools.description: List the line items (services, materials, labor, discounts) on one job, with unit price, cost, quantity and amount in cents. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{job_id}/line_items.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_invoices
tools.title: List a job's invoices
tools.description: List the invoices raised for one job, with status, amounts, due and paid dates, items, taxes, discounts and payments. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{job_id}/invoices.

tools.name: housecall_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices across the company, filterable by status, customer, and created / due / paid date ranges — e.g. everything open and overdue. Amounts are in cents. Housecall Pro: GET /invoices.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

tools.name: housecall_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates, filterable by scheduled window, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each carries its customer, address, schedule and options. Housecall Pro: GET /estimates.

scheduled_start_min.description: Only estimates starting at or after this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_start_max.description: Only estimates starting at or before this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_end_min.description: Only estimates ending at or after this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

scheduled_end_max.description: Only estimates ending at or before this time (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-03-23T15:30:00Z).

employee_ids.description: Only records assigned to these employee ids.

work_status.description: Only these work statuses. All statuses if omitted.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

tools.name: housecall_get_estimate
tools.title: Get one estimate
tools.description: Fetch a single estimate by id, including its options and each option's approval status. Housecall Pro: GET /estimates/{estimate_id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the company's active employees with their role, contact details and permissions. Use their ids to assign or dispatch jobs. Housecall Pro: GET /employees.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

tools.name: housecall_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads, filterable by status (open / won / lost), customer, assigned employees, tags and lead source. Housecall Pro: GET /leads.

employee_ids.description: Only records assigned to these employee ids.

tag_ids.description: Only leads with these tag ids.

lead_source.description: Only leads from these lead sources.

location_ids.description: Multi-location accounts: only these location ids (ignored when HOUSECALL_PRO_COMPANY_ID is set).

tools.name: housecall_get_lead
tools.title: Get one lead
tools.description: Fetch a single lead by id — its customer, address, lead source, tags, assigned employee, status and pipeline status. Housecall Pro: GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_types
tools.title: List job types
tools.description: List the company's job types (e.g. Repair, Install, Maintenance). Use an id as job_type_id when creating a job or estimate. Housecall Pro: GET /job_fields/job_types.

tools.name: housecall_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags defined in the company. Housecall Pro: GET /tags.

tools.name: housecall_list_price_book_services
tools.title: List price book services
tools.description: List or search the price book's services — name, task number, price and cost (cents), taxable and online-booking flags; optionally with their materials and labor rates. Housecall Pro: GET /api/price_book/services.

q.description: Search by name, description or task number.

expand.description: Populate these nested lists (empty by default).

tools.name: housecall_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer, optionally with one or more addresses. Housecall Pro: POST /customers.

addresses.description: Addresses to create with the customer.

tools.name: housecall_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change a customer's name, contact details, tags, lead source, notes or notification setting. Only the fields you pass are sent. Housecall Pro: PUT /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: housecall_create_customer_address
tools.title: Add an address to a customer
tools.description: Add a service address to an existing customer. Returns the address id to use when creating a job or estimate. Housecall Pro: POST /customers/{customer_id}/addresses.

annotations.title: Add an address to a customer

tools.name: housecall_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job for an existing customer at one of their existing addresses, optionally scheduled, assigned, tagged and with line items (prices in cents). Get address ids from housecall_get_customer. Housecall Pro: POST /jobs.

anytime.description: Schedule for any time during the day.

anytime_start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; required when anytime is true.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit, in CENTS.

unit_cost.description: Direct cost of one unit to the company, in CENTS (job costing).

quantity.description: Quantity; up to two decimal places.

invoice_number.description: Must be unique across the company's jobs; auto-assigned if omitted.

tools.name: housecall_update_job_schedule
tools.title: Reschedule a job
tools.description: Set or change a job's scheduled start/end and arrival window, optionally dispatching employees and notifying the customer and/or the pro. Jobs with more than one appointment (multi-day) cannot be rescheduled here. Housecall Pro: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/schedule.

notify.description: Notify the customer of the new schedule.

dispatched_employee_ids.description: Employees to dispatch to the job.

tools.name: housecall_dispatch_job
tools.title: Dispatch a job to employees
tools.description: Set which employees a job is dispatched to. This REPLACES the current dispatch list — pass everyone who should be on the job. Housecall Pro: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/dispatch.

employee_ids.description: Every employee who should be dispatched.

tools.name: housecall_add_job_note
tools.title: Add a note to a job
tools.description: Add a text note to a job. Housecall Pro: POST /jobs/{job_id}/notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a job

tools.name: housecall_create_estimate
tools.title: Create an estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate for a customer with one or more options (e.g. Good / Better / Best), each with line items priced in cents. Give an existing address_id or a new address. Housecall Pro: POST /estimates.

address_id.description: An existing address of the customer.

address.description: A new address, if no address_id.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit, in CENTS.

unit_cost.description: Direct cost of one unit to the company, in CENTS (job costing).

quantity.description: Quantity; up to two decimal places.

schedule.description: When the estimate visit is scheduled.

estimate_number.description: Must be unique across the company's estimates; auto-assigned if omitted.

tools.name: housecall_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Create a lead, either for an existing customer (customer_id) or with a new customer inline (customer). Optionally with an address, lead source, assigned employee, tags, note and line items priced in cents. Housecall Pro: POST /leads.

customer_id.description: An existing customer. Give this or `customer`.

customer.description: A new customer to create with the lead. Give this or `customer_id`.

address_id.description: An existing address of the customer.

address.description: A new address, if no address_id.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit, in CENTS.

unit_cost.description: Direct cost of one unit to the company, in CENTS (job costing).

quantity.description: Quantity; up to two decimal places.
